notes.title: Full-voice action"PixelGameMaker Series Osyaberi! Horijyo! Holin Slash”released!
notes.content:
ladies and gentlemen

"Pixel Game Maker Series Osyaberi! Horijyo! Holin Slash" is a full-voice action game in which the main character, Anna Holinski, talks all the time from startup to play.
Strengthen your equipment, learn new actions, and approach the mysterious group that appears in the ruins of the world!

Please enjoy playing!
